conclusion: The standalone runtime remains a usable host-native boundary only when a public-header consumer can link without simulator front-end or production GPU DSO dependencies.
decision: Retain the public ABI consumer and dependency audit as required regressions while P3-HOST-NATIVE-02 adds a separate simulator adapter behind the accepted wire.
invalidated_assumptions: A runtime ABI stays host-native automatically after simulator-facing build or linkage dependencies are added.
observation: The runtime shared matrix passes 16/16 and the focused Clang ASAN host-native boundary passes 1/1 while auditing forbidden gem5, VEGA_X86, ROCr, KMT, DRM, and management-library dependencies.
question_or_symptom: How can the runtime ABI remain independent while a new host-native simulator front-end is introduced?
